Core ecosystem: fauna (ANIMAL, not EVIL) and sessile (NEVER_MOVE, not evil/undead/demon) spawn neutral. CHARM forces animal neutrality. Vaults force hostility. Replaces the blanket target.midx=-1 fallback.
Fauna AI: territorial animals aggro at half hearing range, skittish prey flee, indifferent animals startle on contact. CHARM suppresses all proximity aggro.
Sessile neutrals (molds, mushrooms) turn hostile only when the player is adjacent (melee range).
Hook fauna behavior into monster_turn before sessile-aggro and ally-seek.
Extend recruitment to neutral animals for players with PF_BEGUILE (Druid specialty). Replaces the player-race-only eligibility check inside recruit-fn.

Three-tier disposition labels: aggressive/aligned/neutral (+territorial sub-label). Replaces ally-look-text's hostile/allied/neutral.
Pull disposition labels outside the RF_PLAYER guard so ALL monsters (including fauna) show aggressive/neutral/aligned labels. recruit-look stays RF_PLAYER-only.
